title: Exercise 2: Add Fractions with Unlike Denominators
description: Practice adding fractions with unlike denominators by creating a common denominator, combining the numerators, and simplifying the result.
instructions: Arithmetic Level 2 is allowed. This permits nested sums and products, the negative unit, and simple nonnegative whole-number exponents.
To rewrite 2/3 with denominator 6, insert multiplication by 1, rewrite that 1 as 2 multiplied by inverse(2), and then use arithmetic and inverse-product tools to form 4/6.
A displayed unit fraction such as 1/7 means inverse(7) itself, not a separate factor 1 multiplied by inverse(7). More generally, a/b is represented as a multiplied by inverse(b).
